title: Build the launch-time availability checks and the refusal path
statement: At every launch resolve the recorded selection, verify an authentication source is configured, verify the package and required tools loaded, verify a matching compatibility record exists, and refuse the run with a specific reason when any check fails.
notes: ⚠️ DEPENDS ON TSK-0042, ADDED 2026-09-22 (B1). The fourth launch check needs the full compatibility key, including the preflight contract digest, and only TSK-0042 (on TSK-0041's canary contract) computes it and writes the record. Without it no launch can show a matching record. ⚠️ THE EXPECTED KEY IS COMPUTED FROM THE CURRENT RUNTIME INPUTS at launch, never read back from the stored record, or the comparison compares the record with itself. ⚠️ A DIFFERENT-MODEL ONE-RUN OVERRIDE NEEDS A ROUTE TO MATCHING COMPATIBILITY PROOF, or the override offered as a remedy can never start a run. ⚠️ WIRED 2026-09-22 (EVD-0132). bin/start-kiln.mjs runs the checks before the supervisor starts anything, with the one-run override flags and a live-canary runner, and holds Pi to the selection that passed. The component work is EVD-0129, and EVD-0131 made the key computable from the resolved model and effective endpoint. ⚠️ STILL OWED: a custom provider cannot launch until the command can supply its credential declaration and provider configuration (D25, D13), and setup (TSK-0060) must call the setup-side live model check so a project's first record is written by setup. ⚠️ AND THAT GAP IS NOW LOAD-BEARING FOR A SECOND REASON (D2, 2026-09-24, EVD-0139). TSK-0061 made the declared non-secret identities a project record `bin/start-kiln.mjs` reads and passes to `checkLaunch`, so the launch side of D22 works — for a built-in provider. A CUSTOM-provider project still cannot be started at all, because this command has no input for the credential declaration `--credential-var` gives setup, and `checkLaunch` refuses it with `unsupported-credential-contract`. Setup can prove such a project; only launching it is owed, and the setup-side control for declared identities therefore reaches `checkLaunch` rather than a started process. ⚠️ AND THE LAUNCHER'S REFUSAL CODES HAVE NO CRITERION (recorded 2026-09-24 with ACC-0084's amendment). ACC-0084 covers `bin/setup.mjs` only: it evaluates CMP-0039, and the two classes it used to name that belong here — launch failure, and a committed selection that cannot be used — cannot be observed through setup, because its selection phase refuses first in every case that would reach the preflight. What is owed is a criterion against CMP-0037, the combined runtime supervisor that raises them, for this command's own refusal classes and the codes it publishes, measured by running it. EVD-0139 states the boundary from setup's side. ⚠️ THE CUSTOM-PROVIDER LAUNCH GAP IS OWNED BY TSK-0072 (2026-09-24), accepted by ACC-0116, and TSK-0063 depends on it.
